validator: Python standard-library ElementTree; independent of application parser and projection
selectionRule: For each branch, first ordinary atom isotope + 1 (H1/C12/N14/O16/S32/P31/F19/Cl35/Br79/I127; other elements 100), otherwise first generic/any query label + _edited, otherwise recurse into first nested group first branch. Element-list position-only edits are rejected.
scope: Strict whole-document and wrapper XML comparison for view files, ignoring only valid ExpandedView markers and indentation. Edited files preserve native chemical identities/hierarchy, all boundary references and native object references. Only the independently predicted isotope/query edits and their labels, derived CIP-cache invalidation, removed Warning/BoundingBox values, explicit equivalent port orders and numerically equivalent layout formatting are accepted and recorded. No RDKit reinterpretation or flattening of ambiguous chemistry.
